# Mary Joe

## Overview

- **Gender:** female (since v2)  <sub>[v2 XIX Just a Happy Day P15](../source/v02-c19.md#nw-v02-c19-p0015)</sub>
- **Origin:** French (since v2)  <sub>[v2 XIX Just a Happy Day P3](../source/v02-c19.md#nw-v02-c19-p0003)</sub>  
  _previously: the creek (v1)_  <sub>[v1 CHAPTER XVIII. Anne to the Rescue P28](../source/v01-c18.md#nw-v01-c18-p0028)</sub>
- **Status:** alive  _(assumed)_

## Appearance

Mary Joe is a young French girl from the creek. She has a buxom build and a broad face.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XVIII. Anne to the Rescue P28](../source/v01-c18.md#nw-v01-c18-p0028)_

## Personality

Mary Joe is described as a silly and ignorant girl whose words should not cause concern. She is also skeptical of others' imaginations, believing a person to be mentally unsound for having dream-people.

_Sources: [v2 XIX Just a Happy Day P15](../source/v02-c19.md#nw-v02-c19-p0015), [v2 XXVII An Afternoon at the Stone House P62](../source/v02-c27.md#nw-v02-c27-p0062)_

## Traits

- ignorant (since v2)  <sub>[v2 XIX Just a Happy Day P15](../source/v02-c19.md#nw-v02-c19-p0015)</sub>
- silly (since v2)  <sub>[v2 XIX Just a Happy Day P15](../source/v02-c19.md#nw-v02-c19-p0015)</sub>
- skeptical of imagination (since v2)  <sub>[v2 XXVII An Afternoon at the Stone House P62](../source/v02-c27.md#nw-v02-c27-p0062)</sub>

## History

Mary Joe is a maid who previously called [Paul Irving](../character/paul-irving.md) strange, prompting [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md) to visit [Paul](../character/paul-irving.md) for tea and reassure him about his imaginative thoughts.
